notes.title: TLP 2.0
notes.content:
In this update, we have worked hard to ensure that most bugs are fixed and the game is more playable.
Keep in mind that it's still a work in progress, we have many more things to do in our game and we will do it as soon as possible ːsteamhappyː.

New things in-game:
- new responsive player movement
- new NPCs 
- animals
- a map full of life and interactions
*Example: construction around the streets
- new weapon (RPG)

Things to come:
- new cutscenes and missions
- improved enemies
- shops and vendors

We hope you will enjoy the new experience we have made in TLP, thank you, and have a nice day.

RealMad Productions
